find.q: How do I find vendors in {{city}} on Vendora?
find.a: Browse the directory and filter by location, or use this page to see only vendors based in or near {{city}}. Each profile shows pricing, real reviews, and direct messaging — no calls or chasing required.

vetted.a: Yes. Every vendor is hand-reviewed by our editorial team for portfolio quality, references, and professional standing before being approved to list — regardless of city.

eventTypes.q: What types of events do {{city}} vendors handle?
eventTypes.a: Weddings, milestone birthdays, holiday gatherings, baby showers, anniversaries, corporate events, and intimate dinners. Use the category filters to narrow down by what you're planning.

timing.q: How early should I book vendors in {{city}}?
timing.a: Peak-season vendors (May-October weddings, December holiday events) often book 9-12 months out. For smaller gatherings or off-peak dates, 6-8 weeks is typically enough — though the most in-demand venues and photographers book earlier.

fees.a: Browsing and contacting vendors is free for hosts. You pay each vendor directly through Vendora's secure messaging and proposal flow — we don't add markups to vendor pricing.
